type.description: The kind of credential being validated — an agent API key or an agent access token.

credential.description: The credential value to validate: the API key value for `api_key`, or the access token (JWT) for `access_token`.

audience.description: When provided, the access token's `aud` claim is verified against this value. Tokens issued for a different resource are rejected.

rationale: The superset access-token member includes the optional audience field; the union host’s discriminator keyword prevents typed union-collapse, so the selected member is installed atomically.
